0022600136.text: The Raptors, hosting the Orlando Magic, are 2-0 and riding a two-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, while the Magic are 0-2 on a two-game losing streak, 4th in the Southeast and 13th in the East. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, Kawhi Leonard, and Nate Bittle, and Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Paolo Banchero. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto in their last meeting on March 29, 2026.
